headline.secondary: Re-engineer the environment around graduate futures.

intro: King's Edge will invert the conventional logic of the wider student journey. The course remains the academic spine. Around it, each student's evolving sense of purpose connects disciplinary learning, wider experiences, relationships and possible futures.

items.title: The graduate premium can no longer be taken for granted.
items.statement: A degree is no longer a guaranteed route to economic security. Students, particularly international students making a substantial investment, need an authentic experience that expands what they can know, do and contribute, together with credible evidence of that value.

items.title: Build a purpose-led graduate-futures ecology.
items.statement: King's will connect disciplinary education, meaningful experience, student agency, recognition and evidence into one responsive institutional environment, rather than relying on isolated services, disconnected opportunities or internship volume.

problem.label: The challenge
problem.summary: King's creates substantial graduate value, but students do not yet encounter it as one coherent, equitable journey.
problem.detail: Strong practice exists across King's, but its strength and visibility vary by course and student group. Opportunities, support and evidence are spread across systems and services, leaving students with unequal burdens of navigation and sense-making. King's Edge will connect and extend what works, while building capacity and making substantive improvements where the experience is weaker.

leadership.title: A different organising model for graduate futures.
leadership.intro: Most universities organise the wider student journey around the course and position careers, skills, experiences and recognition around its edges. King's will retain the course as the academic spine while redesigning the surrounding environment around each student's evolving purpose.

items.title: Purpose-led journey
items.statement: The wider experience is organised around what students are seeking to understand, become and contribute. Purpose remains evolving, plural and student-owned.

items.title: Re-engineered ecology
items.statement: Curriculum, experiences, opportunities, support, recognition and evidence are designed as a connected environment around the student.

items.title: Living bridge to a changing world
items.statement: Disciplinary learning is connected with changing occupations, social challenges and forms of contribution, without narrowing education to job preparation.

items.title: Evidence that changes the system
items.statement: Students build credible accounts of development while responsibly aggregated evidence guides course enhancement, opportunity design and investment.

leadership.claim: King's will offer sector leadership through the depth of integration: purpose as the organising logic, the whole ecology as the unit of design, and evidence as the engine of continuous improvement.

mechanismIntro.title: Four mechanisms make the model work.
mechanismIntro.summary: Purpose provides the organising logic. The mechanisms strengthen what students encounter, connect its value, support meaningful choices and turn evidence into recognition and continuous improvement.

mechanisms.title: Strengthen the experience
mechanisms.summary: King's uses evidence, shared educational principles and student insight to strengthen the substance, quality and equitable reach of the curriculum and wider experiences through which graduate value is created.

levers.title: Evidence-led enhancement
levers.description: Course teams and institutional leaders use evidence to identify strengths, gaps and uneven outcomes, then act through normal enhancement and investment processes.

levers.title: Purposeful educational design
levers.description: Curriculum and wider experiences create meaningful opportunities to apply knowledge, exercise judgement, build relationships and respond to authentic challenges.

levers.title: Equitable reach
levers.description: Strong developmental opportunity becomes less dependent on course, background, networks, confidence or discretionary time.

mechanisms.causalClaim: High-quality, purposeful and appropriately supported experiences are more likely to produce durable intellectual, personal, social and professional development. Evidence allows King's to strengthen what works and intervene where value is weaker or less equitably realised.
outcomes: More students encounter meaningful developmental experiences.
Courses and opportunities become more intentional about the development they enable.
Differences in graduate value between courses and student groups reduce over time.

mechanisms.title: Connect the value
mechanisms.formalTitle: Make graduate value legible and connected
mechanisms.hook: Help students see how their learning and experiences fit together.
mechanisms.summary: King's makes the developmental value of its curriculum and wider student experience more explicit, coherent and understandable, enabling students and staff to recognise how knowledge, capabilities, experiences, relationships and possible futures connect.

levers.title: Explicit developmental possibilities
levers.description: Courses and opportunities describe what students may encounter, practise and develop without assuming that participation alone proves capability.

levers.title: A shared connecting architecture
levers.description: Skills, curriculum, wider experiences, purpose and graduate futures are connected through sufficiently rich common language and information structures.

levers.title: Student sense-making
levers.description: Students receive prompts, reflection and dialogue that help them interpret their development while retaining ownership of the meaning and claims they make.

mechanisms.causalClaim: When developmental possibilities are explicit and connected, students are more likely to notice what they are developing, transfer learning across contexts and understand how separate experiences contribute to a broader trajectory.
outcomes: Students have a richer language for understanding their development.
Students can connect disciplinary learning, skills, wider experiences and future possibilities.
The burden of translating fragmented institutional systems reduces.

mechanisms.title: Support purposeful choices
mechanisms.hook: Help students decide what matters and act on it.
mechanisms.summary: King's supports every student to explore and revisit what matters to them, make informed choices and shape a personally meaningful journey through their course and the wider King's experience.

levers.title: Purpose as a continuing conversation
levers.description: Students are invited to consider their ambitions, needs, contribution and direction throughout their time at King's, with uncertainty treated as a legitimate starting point.

levers.title: Relevant choices and timely support
levers.description: Connected information, digital tools and human relationships help students identify realistic next steps and support at the moments when these are useful.

levers.title: Reduced navigation advantage
levers.description: Simpler routes, accessible design and more integrated provision reduce the advantage held by students who already understand how to find and combine opportunities.

mechanisms.causalClaim: When students can relate available choices to an evolving sense of purpose, and have the confidence and support to act, they are more likely to participate intentionally, sustain engagement and build a coherent developmental journey.
outcomes: Students make more intentional choices about their learning and development.
Participation is better connected to students' purposes, needs and possible futures.
King's uses insight into student demand to shape provision more responsively.

mechanisms.title: Recognise and learn
mechanisms.formalTitle: Recognise, evidence and learn from development
mechanisms.hook: Make development credible and use the evidence to improve.
mechanisms.summary: King's enables students to capture, substantiate and communicate what they have developed, while responsibly aggregated evidence helps courses and the institution improve provision and assert the graduate premium with credibility.

levers.title: Trusted recognition
levers.description: Academic achievement, skills, recognised experiences, credentials and student evidence are connected while maintaining clear distinctions between what is certified, evidenced and claimed.

levers.title: Credible articulation
levers.description: Students can select and translate relevant evidence into accounts of what they know, can do and contribute for different audiences and purposes.

levers.title: Institutional learning
levers.description: Responsibly aggregated evidence, graduate destinations and external validation show where value is strong, uneven or insufficiently evidenced and feed back into improvement.

mechanisms.causalClaim: When students can substantiate and communicate their development, they are better able to carry the value of their education into future settings. When King's can aggregate evidence responsibly, it can improve the underlying experience and make stronger external claims.
outcomes: Students leave with credible evidence of their learning and development.
Courses and King's understand more clearly what their education enables.
Evidence continuously informs enhancement, investment and external articulation.

executiveOutcomes.title: The model creates value at three levels.
executiveOutcomes.intro: A purpose-led ecology should make the student journey more coherent, strengthen distinctive academic provision and give King's a clearer basis for action and credible external claims.

items.statement: A coherent journey shaped around evolving purpose, with fairer access to meaningful experiences and credible evidence of what they can contribute.
Better insight and shared infrastructure to strengthen, connect and articulate distinctive disciplinary provision.
A clear view of where graduate value is strong, uneven or in need of action, with evidence to support investment and external claims.

proofPoints.title: What progress will look like
proofPoints.intro: The model becomes tangible through a small number of visible changes in practice, capability and evidence.

items.title: Purpose through the journey
items.statement: Every student is invited to explore and revisit what matters to them, with uncertainty treated as a legitimate starting point.

items.title: Course-level intelligence
items.statement: Course teams use connected graduate-futures evidence to make credible claims, identify strengths and agree proportionate enhancements.

items.title: Connected architecture
items.statement: A shared skills and opportunity architecture links curriculum, experiences, student evidence and possible futures.

items.title: Living evidence
items.statement: Students build a credible account of learning and contribution that develops throughout their time at King's.

operatingPrinciplesIntro.title: Faculty-owned, institutionally connected.
operatingPrinciplesIntro.summary: The direction is ambitious, but delivery must preserve disciplinary ownership, build common capabilities once and scale only when value and responsibility are clear.

facultyEnablement.title: Faculty-led, centrally enabled
facultyEnablement.summary: Faculties own disciplinary interpretation and enhancement. King's provides shared evidence, language, platforms and connective capacity that are stronger when built once.
facultyEnablement.detail: King's Edge strengthens and connects existing practice rather than rebadging it. It supports local ownership of claims and enhancement, targets additional help where capacity or outcomes are weaker, and reduces the need for faculties to recreate common infrastructure.

deliveryPrinciple.title: Built progressively, reused institutionally
deliveryPrinciple.summary: The ecology will be re-engineered through sequenced, reusable capabilities rather than a single launch or an immediate universal service promise.
deliveryPrinciple.detail: Early deliverables test the mechanisms while building shared evidence, data, digital, opportunity and recognition capabilities. These should be developed once where possible, reused across courses and services, and scaled only when benefits, ownership and recurrent operating costs are explicit.

equity.title: For every student
equity.summary: The model succeeds only if the ability to benefit becomes less dependent on course, background, mode of study, confidence, prior networks or discretionary time.
equity.detail: King's must examine who encounters developmental opportunity, who can interpret and navigate it, whose development is recognised and whether different groups realise comparable value.

feedback.title: Evidence closes the loop
feedback.summary: Evidence from students, courses, graduate destinations and external audiences flows back into educational design, opportunity development, support and investment.

northStar.statement: King's Edge makes the King's graduate premium real, visible, navigable and evidenced for every student.

deliveryCta.title: See the model become delivery
deliveryCta.summary: Explore the projects and deliverables through which King's Edge will test, build and mobilise this purpose-led graduate-futures ecology.
deliveryCta.label: Explore the projects

hypothesis.if: King's organises the wider student journey around evolving purpose, strengthens the substance and equitable reach of the experience, connects its developmental value and enables learning to be recognised and evidenced,
hypothesis.then: students will be better able to access meaningful opportunities, make purposeful choices, build a coherent journey and articulate what they can contribute,
hypothesis.while: King's becomes better able to understand where graduate value is strong or uneven, improve the ecology and assert the graduate premium with credibility.
